page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.8xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs, utilizing an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core.

This server does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, requiring external block storage for operating system and application data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures that compute resources are not shared with other tenants, providing consistent execution times for CPU-bound workloads.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this instance as a resource-dense option for compute-heavy tasks that do not require massive memory footprints. It is designed for workloads such as web serving, batch processing, and compute-intensive applications that benefit from dedicated Intel Xeon physical cores.
